prompts: One transparent oblique ink-and-watercolor atlas sprite for small Bethlehem circa 1180. About eight modest flat-roof limestone houses and courtyards on a small hill beside the larger Justinian Nativity basilica with simple pitched roof and eastern apses, understated 12th-century adjunct. Compact scale, no city wall, modern square, towers or Gothic facades. Warm stone, subdued earth colors, finely drawn atlas style. Fully isolated footprint with generous zero-alpha padding. No background, shadows outside footprint, letters, flags or frame.

One small settlement sprite for Botron / Batroun circa 1180. Historical ink and muted watercolor atlas cutout, oblique view. Compact Levantine fishing port with six to ten stone houses, small plain Frankish fortified house among the cottages, modest slipway and narrow sliver of rocky shoreline. Avoid monumental castle, entire seawall, large harbor, modern church, lighthouse, labels, flags. Keep coastal footprint small and schematic. Generous real transparent padding on all sides, no vignette or background. Fine warm limestone texture and terracotta accents.

One small settlement sprite for Larnaca, Cyprus circa 1180. Oblique fine ink and watercolor, muted buff limestone, terracotta and olive. A compact handful of simple houses and courtyard plots around a low Byzantine stone church of Saint Lazarus, with three modest low domes along a long narrow roof, no tall belfry, no later Gothic porch. Small flat coastal ground patch, no large harbor or fortress, no modern promenade or minaret. Village-scale schematic, sharply bounded transparent PNG, true alpha, generous padding, no text or backdrop.
